leads.title: Bermuda Human Rights Act 1981 (amended 2013)
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination on basis of sexual orientation since 2013; used as basis for marriage-equality rulings
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as 'Human Rights Act' and 'Human Rights Act 1981' with sections 2(2)(a)(ii) and 5 referenced

leads.title: Marriage Act 1944
leads.documents: Found inconsistent with Human Rights Act in May 2017 ruling to allow same-sex marriage
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited by name only in Recognition of same-sex relationships section

leads.title: Supreme Court ruling May 2017 - Godwin and DeRoche case, Justice Charles-Etta Simmons
leads.documents: Legalised same-sex marriage; found denial of marriage license was discrimination on basis of sexual orientation
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; described as case by Winston Godwin and Greg DeRoche denied license July 2016

leads.title: Domestic Partnership law passed December 2017
leads.documents: Replaced same-sex marriage with domestic partnerships; royal assent 7 February 2018, effective 1 June 2018
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; described as PLP Government law, Governor gave royal assent, first territory to reverse marriage rights by legislation

leads.title: Supreme Court ruling 6 June 2018
leads.documents: Revoked parts of 2017/2018 law that prevented same-sex couples from marrying; stayed for appeal
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; described as hearing in May 2018 after two challenges filed by April 2018

leads.title: Court of Appeal ruling 23 November 2018
leads.documents: Upheld Supreme Court June 2018 ruling, allowing same-sex marriages to resume
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited by date only

leads.title: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council ruling 14 March 2022
leads.documents: Ruled for Attorney General on appeal from Court of Appeal, banning same-sex marriage again; followed by July 2022 retrospective backdating laws
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited by date and parties only

leads.title: Criminal Code - Stubbs Bill 1994 and 1 November 2019 amendment
leads.documents: Legalised consensual private sexual conduct in 1994 with unequal age of consent; 2019 amendment set universal age for anal intercourse at 18 and repealed gross indecency between men
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as 'Stubbs Bill in 1994', 'Criminal Code', age 18 vs 16 discrepancy

leads.title: Supreme Court adoption ruling February 2015, Hellman J - Adoption of Children Act
leads.documents: Found direct discrimination on marital status and indirect on sexual orientation in adoption denial; Act applies equally to married/non-married and same-sex couples
leads.detail: No URL visible in provided text; cited as Judge Hellman J ruling, Adoption of Children Act
